description: Renovate config for tofu-github-action. Self-contained — no shared preset. Tracks GitHub Actions (SHA-pinned with version comment) and npm dependencies. The bundled distribution and the hash-locked checkov pip lockfiles are explicitly excluded.
schedule: before 8am on the first day of the month

prBodyNotes: **Security update** — Renovate raised this PR in response to a vulnerability advisory affecting one or more direct or transitive dependencies.
The 7-day quarantine and the monthly schedule are bypassed for security-driven updates so the fix can be reviewed and merged promptly.
Review the advisory details before merging.
Review release notes for breaking changes before merging.
All Renovate PRs require human review — automerge is disabled.

packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR per run to reduce review burden.
Group npm devDependency bumps; marked chore so they don't cut semantic-releases on their own.
npm runtime dependencies stay separate so an action-impacting bump shows clearly in commit history.
cycjimmy/semantic-release-action is load-bearing for releases — own PR so changes get explicit review.
